name: AI Vision Enrichment
summary: Tags, captions, auto alt text, and OCR for uploaded images. Network-bound, so it bills at the cheap waiting rate.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential for the vision model. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: VISION_PREFIX
env.description: Watched key prefix. Non-images under it are recorded as skipped, since storage triggers have no suffix filter.

env.name: VISION_MODEL
env.description: Vision-capable model. Must accept image inputs.

env.name: VISION_OUTPUTS
env.description: Comma-separated outputs: tags, caption, altText, ocr, colors. All are requested in one call, because image tokens dominate the cost.

env.name: VISION_URL_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Lifetime of the presigned URL handed to the model provider. Short, because it leaves your infrastructure.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Strongly recommended: each analysis costs a model call, so a forged event costs money.

triggers.description: Required by §5. Analyses images the trigger missed, bounded per run to cap model spend.

operations.title: POST /analyze
operations.description: storage trigger, or queue-driven — analyse one image

operations.title: POST /reconcile
operations.description: cron — retry failures, find images the trigger missed

operations.title: GET /search
operations.description: tag and OCR search over analysed images
